title: Superfluid Dark Matter (Khoury)
efc_relevance: DM undergoes BEC phase transition inside galaxies, producing MOND-like force via phonon exchange; retains CDM-like behaviour at cluster scales. One of the more sophisticated hybrids. Shares the MOND-limit galactic regime with EFC but achieves it through superfluid phonons rather than entropic field.
ledger_action: Logged as hybrid-regime competitor. Required comparison on galactic ↔ cluster transition.
